title: Text: DET Marc Himelstein ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Were you with Tigers in 2010? For Galarraga game?

I’m working on an “oral history” about it, if you have any behind-the-scenes info from your perspective. Quotes would be best but given what we’ve talked about in the past, I can understand you not wanting to be quoted on anything. But any behind the scenes info, I can use on background for details in story and not quote you
